lang_usage: ℹ️ Language Settings: Usage: .botlang tr or .botlang en Current: {lang}
settings_desc: Toggle features or configure parameters below:
cat_header: 📂 {category} COMMANDS ──────────────────────── Tap a command below to inspect details and usage examples:
cmd_ban_info: Bans a specified user from the group.
cmd_unban_info: Unbans a previously banned user from the group.
cmd_mute_info: Mutes a user, preventing them from sending messages.
cmd_unmute_info: Unmutes a muted user in the group.
cmd_purge_info: Deletes all messages from the replied message onwards.
cmd_delme_info: Deletes your last N sent messages in the current chat.
cmd_lock_info: Locks specified media types or permissions in the chat.
cmd_unlock_info: Unlocks previously locked media types or permissions.
cmd_afk_info: Activates Away From Keyboard (AFK) status with an optional custom reason.
cmd_otomesaj_info: Opens the scheduled automatic message broadcast management panel.
cmd_ilet_info: Broadcasts replied message, text, or media to all active target groups.
cmd_iletmenu_info: Interactive menu to toggle active target groups for broadcasting.
cmd_bypass_info: Bypasses shortened, protected, or ad-based URLs (ouo, bitly, tinyurl, etc.).
cmd_rehbermenu_info: Interactive contacts and group member management panel.
cmd_grupaktar_info: Directly transfers members from one group into another.
cmd_rehberekle_info: Saves active group members into your Telegram contacts list.
cmd_grubaekle_info: Invites contacts from your phonebook/contacts into the selected group.
cmd_rehbersayi_info: Displays the total count of registered contacts.
cmd_rehbersil_info: Removes the specified user from your contacts list.
cmd_rapidapi_info: Configures and manages RapidAPI tokens for Instagram extraction.
cmd_ig_info: Interactive Instagram profile analyzer, story, reels, and post downloader.
cmd_yuvarlak_info: Converts replied video into a 1:1 round video note (Telescope).
cmd_ses_info: Converts replied video or audio file into a Telegram voice message.
cmd_sticker_info: Converts replied image into a standard Telegram sticker (WebP).
cmd_tts_info: Transforms input text into speech and sends as a voice message.
cmd_stt_info: Transcribes voice notes and audio messages into text via Google Speech.
cmd_install_info: Installs a custom plugin at runtime by replying to a .py file or from store.
cmd_uninstall_info: Unloads and deletes a previously installed custom plugin.
cmd_plugins_info: Lists all built-in core plugins and active custom plugins.
cmd_antidelete_info: Toggles automatic capture of deleted messages in direct messages (DM).
cmd_sureli_info: Captures and archives view-once / self-destructing media into admin topics.
cmd_setyedekgrup_info: Manually binds the main Admin / Archive group ID.
cmd_lang_info: Configures and switches userbot language (e.g. .lang tr / .lang en).
cmd_setalive_info: Sets a custom banner image for the alive card or resets to default.
cmd_alive_info: Displays real-time system metrics, resource usage, and control center.
cmd_ayarlar_info: Opens interactive control panel to toggle userbot modules and settings.
cmd_durum_info: Detailed diagnostic report of system hardware (CPU, RAM, Disk, Uptime).
cmd_update_info: Checks GitHub for new updates (.update) or automatically pulls and restarts (.update now).
cmd_ping_info: Measures real-time latency (ping ms) between userbot and Telegram servers.
cmd_restart_info: Gracefully restarts userbot process without touching server terminal.
cmd_tag_info: Mentions/tags chat members or administrators in batches.
cmd_ttcookie_info: Manages TikTok session cookies for HD scraping.
cmd_tttakip_info: Adds a TikTok creator to automatic live stream recording & alert watch.
cmd_tttakiptencikar_info: Removes a TikTok creator from live recording watch list.
cmd_dil_info: Sets default target translation language (e.g. .dil en).
cmd_cevir_info: Translates replied message into configured default target language.
cmd_yt_info: Downloads media from YouTube, TikTok, X, and Reddit at highest quality.
cmd_tg_info: Saves replied Telegram media or link directly into admin archive.
cmd_whois_info: Performs comprehensive profile & entity intelligence on a user.
cmd_ocr_info: Extracts text from images using optical character recognition (OCR).
